title: No structure sheet explicitly guarantees a one-entry maximum; S1 classifications are evidence-based
detail: All 37 official DSE IV structure sheets were read. None explicitly says 'one entry only' or promises a freezeout. The site nevertheless marks 53 event rows 'Confirmed single-entry (standard S1)' because each row's own sheet was read and no rule grants a second entry under the published S1 test; this is not a venue guarantee. The other 41 rows are classified as multi-entry under the same standard. Obtain a written event-specific cap from the tournament desk before treating any event as a guaranteed freezeout. Per-row evidence and the full standard are on the Verification page. Re-read 2026-11-19 (session 0a0d8e6b, data/0a0d8e6b/sheet_reread.json): the 22 structure sheets behind the 53 rows were read line by line. Their start times, buy-ins, guarantees, starting chips, late-registration closes, house fees and prize pools match the stored rows on 53 of 53 rows. None of the 22 sheets contains a written one-entry, maximum-entry, re-entry, rebuy or add-on sentence. The label therefore means 'no re-entry, rebuy or add-on wording found on the sheet', not 'written single-entry rule'. User decision: keep the label with this definition, or relabel these rows as 'no re-entry wording found'.

title: Venetian multi-flight events allow more than one entry
detail: Events 01, 07, 19, 26, 47, 49, 56 and 59 have multiple starting flights, and each sheet carries the rule 'Any player who bags chips for Day 2 may not play a subsequent flight', which only restricts a player who has bagged. They are listed as multi-entry, not single-entry.

title: Events #18 and #58 reference 'subsequent buy in's'
detail: Structure sheet 8 (PokerAtlas Valuetown Bounty) states 'All subsequent buy in's after the initial buy in will be $200', which shows more than one buy-in per player is possible.

title: Every WPT / Wynn event whose terms were read permits re-entry
detail: Re-checked 2026-11-19 against all 14 event sections in the official structures PDF: unlimited re-entry on the $600, $800, $1,100 PLO, $1,600, TORSE, HORSE, Mixed Triple Draw, Limit Omaha 8, Limit Omaha 8/Stud 8, $600 NLH Turbo and $1,600 PLO Mystery Bounty events; the $1,100 WPT Prime Championship allows one entry plus one re-entry per starting flight. The Wynn daily structures PDF likewise states a re-entry fee on its $200 events, and 'Re-entry is NOT allowed' only on the $240 Friday NLH Rebuy & Add-on, which sells extra chips by rebuy ($200 for 25,000 chips while at 15,000 or less) and one $100 add-on instead. No WPT/Wynn event of any kind meets standard S1.

title: WPT schedule PDF date error: a block is labelled 'Dec. 18 Wednesday'
detail: The block sits between Tuesday 15 December and Thursday 17 December and is headed 'Dec. 18 Wednesday'. 18 December 2026 is a Friday; the Wednesday of that week is 16 December. Those rows are dated 2026-12-16 here.

title: WPT continuation rows repeat the parent buy-in and guarantee
detail: The row 'Dec. 5 Saturday 11 a.m. No Limit Hold'em Day 2' shows $1,100 and $5,000,000, which are the Prime Championship's values, not a separate entry price. Continuation rows are marked as such and excluded from entry counts.

title: Wynn daily tournaments: suspension policy does not name the WPT series
detail: The official page says 'the Daily Tournament schedule will be suspended during each Wynn Signature, Wynn Millions, and Classic tournament series'. It does not say whether the WPT World Championship (27 Nov - 21 Dec 2026) suspends them.

title: Wynn / Encore resort fee: now stated by an official page, but it is a rate-plan term
detail: RESOLVED AS TO FIGURE on 2026-11-19: the official Wynn special-offer terms whose window covers the planned stay state "A daily resort fee of $55 plus tax ..." and include complimentary self-parking for up to two vehicles. It is still not a property-wide published rate: confirm the fee on the rate plan you book.
status: resolved - figure official, applicability at booking

title: Caesars Palace and Horseshoe resort fees not verified
detail: The official resort-fee URLs redirect to the hotel landing pages and do not state a fee. Fields left blank.

title: MGM Resorts rooms (Bellagio, MGM Grand, ARIA): resort fee and cancellation term now read from official pages
detail: CLOSED AS TO FEE AND TERM on 2026-11-19. Official hotel reservation terms were read for three MGM properties: Bellagio and ARIA state 'A daily resort fee of $55.00 plus applicable tax will be applied to all reservations'; MGM Grand states '$50.00'. All three state a first-night deposit refundable up to 72 hours before arrival unless the booked offer excludes it, and the MGM parking page states $20 self-parking for registered hotel guests and $40 valet. MGM fees are property-specific, so no single MGM figure is reused. Still open: no MGM room rate for 6-13 December 2026 is published on any page read, and the MGM poker-room URLs still return no page, so MGM rooms remain absent from the tournament tables (no row was invented).

title: Horseshoe publishes no poker schedule: the casino page promises six daily tournament times but prints none
detail: Re-read on 2026-11-19: the official Horseshoe casino page states 'The Hall of Fame Poker Room at Horseshoe Las Vegas features 20 tables ... Test your luck with 6 exciting tournament times daily', and links no schedule, buy-in, guarantee or structure sheet. The claim that tournaments run is official; the times, prices and entry rules are not published anywhere this site can read, so no Horseshoe row is created and none is guessed.

title: South Point publishes its schedule as images only
detail: Times (10:10, 14:10, 18:10, 22:10) and buy-ins ($120, $300) come from the official page text. Guarantees, levels and entry rules are inside image files and were not read. South Point is also off-Strip and not walkable to it.

title: Resorts World tournament schedule not retrieved
detail: The official site has a poker-room section under Gaming, but no schedule or structure sheet was retrieved.

title: No official page publishes a dated nightly rate for the trip dates
detail: The only numeric room rate any Strip property publishes is the Venetian poker suite rate, '$119 and $209' starting ('and can be higher'), which is a published floor and not a quote for 6-13 December 2026. The 2026-12-02 to 2026-12-09 booking-engine total in the dated rate log is a 2026-11-16 snapshot from a different window. Every rate cell therefore stays blank on purpose, and the trip-cost calculator reports 'Incomplete' until a dated quote is recorded.

title: Cross-property walking times are not published officially
detail: Only hotel-to-its-own-poker-room (0 minutes, same property) is verified. Every other pair is blank and carries a route link so you can check it yourself. No walking time is estimated or filled in.

title: Some events have no guarantee on the official sheet
detail: Event #06 and the RaceDay Stack events #03, #04 and #05 state no guarantee on the structure sheet. The guarantee field is left blank rather than copied from the schedule text or inferred.

title: Per-flight differences inside one event number
detail: Event #01 has two sheets (Day A+C, 40-minute levels, registration closes ~3:40 PM; Day B+D, 30-minute levels, closes ~8:40 PM). Event #26 has three sheets (A+C+E 40 min; B+D 30 min; Day F Turbo 20 min). Rows point at their own sheet.

detail: The official page row reads '$600 Pot Limit Omaha Bounty $25K GTD (1Day)' with structure sheet 27, which confirms event 40, $600 buy-in and a $25,000 guarantee. Resolved; no longer flagged as unknown.

title: Earlier root pages claimed 31 confirmed single-entry events
detail: The 37-sheet audit behind this build found zero explicit single-entry statements, so the root pages were rebuilt. Earlier sessions' dashboards are preserved under their own folders and are not edited.

title: Room-tax rate confirmed as 13.38% for resort hotels in the primary gaming corridor
detail: Re-checked on 2026-11-19 against two Clark County sources: the Senate Bill 1 ordinance table ('Resort hotel within primary gaming corridor ... 13.38%') and the Department of Business License notice adopting the increase ('Transient Lodging Establishments located within the Primary Gaming Corridor will impose a combined transient lodging tax rate of 13.38 percent'). Whether the county tax applies on top of the resort fee is a hotel-by-hotel practice question, so the calculator states the assumption on screen.

title: Some WPT festival events still have no terms section in the official structures PDF
detail: Every event terms-and-conditions section printed in the official WPT World Championship structures PDF was read on 2026-11-19 (14 sections: $600 NLH, TORSE, $400 PLO, Mixed Triple Draw, $800 NLH, Limit Omaha 8, Limit Omaha 8/Stud 8, $1,100 PLO, $1,600 NLH, HORSE, WPT Prime Championship, $600 NLH Turbo, $1,600 PLO Mystery Bounty, plus the General Terms). Every one of them grants re-entry, so none can pass S1. 47 rows are covered by those sections (38 flights/entries plus 9 continuation days). The 89 rows below are not: milestone satellites, the Seniors, Ladies, High Roller, Big O, 6-Max, 8-Max and Turbo events and the $3,000 and $10,400 championships have no section in that PDF at all, and three names ('No Limit Hold'em Day 1A', 'No Limit Hold'em Day 1B', 'No Limit Hold'em') are used by more than one event with different buy-ins, so no section can be matched to a row without guessing. Those rows keep the unread label. See F60 for the same finding stated from the schedule side.

title: Caesars Palace daily flyer does not state which days it runs
detail: The official flyer gives four start times and buy-ins but no days of the week. Rows are shown as 'Daily' and flagged.

title: Wynn daily tournaments: all four structures are re-entry, rebuy or add-on
detail: The official Wynn daily structures PDF states a re-entry fee for the $200 Monday-Thursday, $200 Saturday, $200 Sunday and $160 nightly events, plus unlimited $200 rebuys and a $100 add-on on the $240 Friday event. No Wynn daily tournament is a freezeout. All five are listed on the multi-entry page.

title: Wynn dailies may not run during the WPT World Championship
detail: The official page says dailies are suspended during Wynn Signature, Wynn Millions and Classic series. It does not say whether the WPT World Championship (27 Nov - 21 Dec 2026) suspends them. The structures PDF only says 'may be suspended during Seniors Events, Classic Events, or other Tournament Series'.

title: The Venetian series page still labels the WPT Fall Festival as the current series
detail: On 17 November 2026 the official page shows 'Current Series: WPT Fall Festival October 28 - November 15, 2026' while listing DeepStack Extravaganza IV (16 Nov - 23 Dec 2026) as the next series. The DSE IV rows are used because they are the current window; the label on the official page lags.

title: Horseshoe and Resorts World publish no poker schedule at all
detail: Horseshoe's official casino page says the Hall of Fame Poker Room has 20 tables and '6 exciting tournament times daily' but links no schedule. A guessed Caesars content-dam URL for a Horseshoe flyer returned an empty document. Resorts World's site has a poker-room section under Gaming with no schedule. No rows invented.

title: Venetian poker room is in The Palazzo, not The Venetian tower
detail: The official poker-room page states the room is at The Palazzo on level 2 of Grand Canal Shoppes, reached from The Venetian lobby via the Waterfall Atrium escalator. Allow indoor walking time if you stay in the Venetian tower, and note the room is a long inside walk from the Strip entrance.

title: Three generators fought over the one published root site
detail: Until 2026-11-19 the repo contained three root-site builders (build_c6087e2c.py, build_251c122f.py, build_ea99006a.py) and three workflows that each rebuilt the root pages with a different one. CI regenerated the site with none of the published output, so the live pages could silently change generator between automated runs. Resolved 2026-11-19: scripts/build_ea99006a.py is the only root-site generator; the morning capture workflow commits capture data only; Quality checks regenerates the site and fails on drift.

title: Stale root pages from a retired generator contradicted the entry standard
detail: pages/qa.html, pages/flagged.html, pages/multientry.html and pages/sources.html were left behind by the retired 251c122f build and described a different single-entry verdict count than the published site. They were not linked from the published navigation. Resolved 2026-11-19: each is now a redirect stub to its canonical page.

title: Monitor ledger tracked unfetchable booking-template URLs as sources
detail: Official booking links that contain {IN}/{OUT} date placeholders were hashed by the source monitor and produced noise 'changed' events. Resolved 2026-11-19: template URLs are labelled as templates, excluded from hashing, and no row's 'source changed' badge can be caused by them.

title: Root-site link checker misread data-nosrc attributes as src links
detail: scripts/check_root_site.py matched the 'src' inside 'data-nosrc="1"' and reported broken links '1'. Fixed 2026-11-19 with a word-boundary match.

title: Dated stay captures are sparse and not like-for-like
detail: Only two dated booking-engine stay snapshots (Venetian Dec 2-9 and Dec 13-20) and one dated poker-suite-rate observation exist, each with a different occupancy (2 adults vs 1 adult) and different stay windows. Checkout totals, nightly averages, tax amounts and cancellation deadlines are blank wherever the booking UI did not return them (Wynn returned no tax-inclusive total at all). No hotel ranking is published from these, and the trip planner stays Incomplete without a date-specific quote.

title: Per-stay parking cost and cancellation deadline are not captured for every hotel
detail: Parking terms are captured per property (Venetian player-parking page; Wynn parking page), but what a specific stay will add at checkout, and each hotel's cancellation deadline for the planned rate, is only known for Wynn (48 hours before arrival for offer DK26WLV2 bookings, re-read 2026-11-19; the earlier 72-hour figure is withdrawn, see F55). Blank elsewhere and flagged.

title: Caesars Palace and Horseshoe publish only a $45-$60 corporate range, not a property fee
detail: Read from the official Caesars Entertainment disclaimer on 2026-11-19: 'Room reservations are subject to a daily resort fee between $45-$60 plus applicable tax. Resort fees are waived for Diamond and Seven Stars.' A range cannot be compared like-for-like against a fixed $55 fee, so both hotels stay without a single fee value and the exact figure must be read at booking.

title: Structure sheet 8 grants later buy-ins; legacy capture still misclassifies #18 and #58
detail: Structure sheet 8 ($200 NLH PokerAtlas Valuetown Bounty, events #18 on 28 Nov and #58 on 19 Dec) states: 'All subsequent buy in's after the initial buy in will be $200', which permits more than one paid entry. The canonical dashboard classifies both rows as multi-entry and keeps them out of the confirmed-single list. Irregularity: the separate legacy capture data/c6087e2c/events_verified.json still marks both single_entry_confirmed, and its current cross-check passes because the classifier does not recognize this wording. That capture is not the canonical published dataset; request a classifier/cross-check repair before using it as a decision source. The S1 test now reads the whole rule list, not only re-entry/rebuy/add-on keywords.
status: open: legacy capture classifier/cross-check repair requested; canonical dashboard corrected

title: Whole-page hashing marked 48 of 96 official sources 'changed' on the first nightly run
detail: The monitor hashed every page as delivered. Casino pages carry per-request tokens and timestamps, so a 2-byte difference was recorded as a source change for half the ledger, and 'mark rows whose source changed' would have lit up rows whose values never moved. The monitor now compares extracted VALUES (scripts/monitor_b3be876c.py): the resort-fee sentence, the guarantee line, the registration-close line and the schedule row text. A row is marked only when one of those sentences changes; the raw page hash is kept as an informational column.

title: Two scheduled jobs both wrote the root site and overwrote each other
detail: daily-scrape.yml committed the output of scripts/build_c6087e2c.py to index.html and pages/, while recheck-ea99006a.yml committed the output of scripts/build_ea99006a.py to the same paths. Their headline counts disagree (0 vs 55 confirmed single-entry), so main alternated between two published sites; HEAD fd8edf2 was an automated re-check that overwrote the root site merged six minutes earlier in PR #47. Both jobs now produce the site through one generator and one integration step, and quality.yml fails if the committed root site is not the canonical build's output.

title: No official source states a walking time between two Strip properties
detail: Verified again on 2026-11-19: the Venetian publishes a resort fee, a player-parking rule and its poker-room location ('The Palazzo, level 2 of Grand Canal Shoppes'), and the Wynn terms publish poker-room parking, but no property publishes a walking minute figure to another property. Minute cells therefore stay blank, the 30-minute filter only acts on values recorded by you, and each pair carries a maps deep link measured from the official street addresses.

title: The true-cost figure the planner needs cannot be completed from official data alone
detail: Cost of the trip = entries x buy-ins + nights x true nightly hotel cost. The first term is complete for every confirmed single-entry row (buy-in and house fee both come from the sheet). The second term needs a dated nightly rate, which no official page publishes for the trip dates (see F14), so the planner shows 'Incomplete' rather than a total with a zero-cost hotel.

title: Interrupted-session note about a 'Dec 4 $400 Mega Stack' ($20K vs $25K) cannot be matched to any schedule
detail: A research session that was interrupted (workspace reset) left a note that a Dec 4 '$400 Mega Stack' structure sheet showed a $20,000 guarantee, not $25,000. No row with that name exists in the captured schedules or on the live official Venetian DSE IV page (re-checked 2026-11-19: Dec 4 shows only Event #26 $800 NLH flights 1C/1D, $500K GTD). A web search suggests the note referred to the Venetian DeepStack Extravaganza New Year's Edition '$400 NLH Monster Stack / UltimateStack Freeze Out' rows printed with a $20,000 guarantee in January. No row was added or changed; this flag records the claim for manual review.

title: Interrupted-session Bellagio daily-flyer prices ($200 / $300 / $240 / $320 / $400, 10 AM) could not be re-verified
detail: The interrupted session reported Bellagio daily tournament rows from a 'cash-game flyer' at $200 / $300 / $240 / $320 / $400 with a 10:00 AM start. No official Bellagio page or PDF in this repository prints those rows, and room reviews state Bellagio runs tournaments only for special events (its official PDFs cover the Friday, Saturday and Sunday specials already captured). Nothing was added; the claim is recorded here so it can be checked against the flyer the session was reading.

title: Interrupted-session dated hotel rate snapshots ($241.93 Venetian Dec 2, $277.33 Bellagio Dec 3) not re-verifiable
detail: The interrupted session recorded two dated hotel rate observations ($241.93 Venetian for Dec 2, $277.33 Bellagio for Dec 3) with extraction notes. The booking engines are JavaScript-driven and the figures could not be re-read from an official booking page, so they were NOT added to the dated rates log - a rate enters the log only with its official source and retrieval timestamp (see F14/F51). Re-run the official booking pages for those dates and capture the itemised quote (checkout total, nightly average, resort fee, tax, parking, cancellation deadline) to add them properly.

title: Wynn cancellation deadline: 72 hours was not reproducible; the live offer terms say 48 hours
detail: Several records (rate snapshots, Q14, F33) stated a Wynn cancellation deadline of '72 hours before arrival, per the Wynn terms page read 2026-11-17'. No stored capture contains that text, so it cannot be reproduced. The Wynn terms page re-read on 2026-11-19 (offer DK26WLV2) says 'cancellations must be received at least 48 hours prior to arrival date or deposit will be forfeited', and its longer full-deposit and cancellation policy applies only to stays on 15-21 Nov, 29-31 Dec 2026 and 4-6 Jan 2027, not to 6-13 Dec. The 72-hour figure is therefore withdrawn and the record now carries 48 hours, labelled as the offer's terms. The standard (non-offer) rate policy was not read, so the planned rate's deadline is still unconfirmed. Re-read the booking-engine rate rules at quote time before any payment.

title: Event #35 is a two-person team event but is stored as a single-entry row
detail: The official sheet for event #35 ($600 NLH LIPS Poker Jingle Tag Team, sheet 31, start 10:10 AM, guarantee $10,000) is a team format: 'Teams will rotate their players at the start of every level' and teams must be Female / Female or Female / Male. The row is stored as confirmed single-entry (standard S1), the same as the individual events. A two-person team is not an individual single-entry freezeout in the sense of the brief. Review its classification before the single-entry filter is used for it.

title: 'TDA rules apply' is cited by all 22 single-entry sheets; the rulebook text was not captured
detail: Every single-entry sheet read on 2026-11-19 opens its rule list with 'TDA rules apply to all Venetian Poker Room tournaments'. That is a reference to an external rulebook, not a rule written on the sheet. The rulebook text was not read, so any entry limit it contains is unknown to this dashboard. No official Venetian house-rules page covering re-entry was located in this session. Obtain the house-rules text from the poker room desk before payment.

detail: Structures PDF: the $800 No Limit Hold'em Day 2 is Thu Dec 3 at 1 p.m. (the schedule prints Mon Nov 30 1 p.m.); the $1,600 No Limit Hold'em Day 2 is Sat Dec 5 at 11 a.m. (the schedule prints Thu Dec 3 1 p.m.). Rows 2026-11-30 13:00, 2026-12-03 13:00 and 2026-12-05 11:00 keep the schedule's date and buy-in, so their date is not confirmed by the structures PDF. Ask the Wynn poker desk which date is correct before planning a Day 2.

detail: The structures PDF lists the Monday Dec 21 NLH Turbo at 6 p.m.; the official schedule lists 8 p.m. The row keeps the schedule time (20:00). Confirm before relying on it.

title: 91 WPT schedule lines have no entry terms in the document the site cited for them
detail: All 136 WPT rows match the official schedule on date, start time and buy-in, and on guarantee where the schedule prints one (see data/98087225/wpt_schedule_check.json). The structures PDF (read in full on 2026-11-19) contains terms for 13 events only, and 45 site rows match them (re-entry granted, so classified multi). The other 91 lines (Milestone satellites, Super Gold Million Mystery Bounty, Seniors, Ladies, High Roller, Big O, PLO 6-Max, the Dec 18 NLH and NLH Turbo variants and similar) are not in it. Their rows previously cited that PDF; they now cite the schedule, and their entry terms remain unread and unverified. The schedule says 'See structure sheet for details'; those sheets were not located.

title: WPT schedule PDF prints two different weeks under a 'Dec. 18' heading
detail: The official schedule PDF's 16 December block is headed 'Dec. 18 Wednesday' (18 December 2026 is a Friday; Wednesday is the 16th), and the block that follows it is headed 'Dec. 18 Friday' with a different set of events and start times. One of the two blocks must be misdated, and the PDF alone cannot say which: the first block's weekday disagrees with its printed date, the second block's agrees. Rows are stored under 16 December with the discrepancy printed on the row (F05 is the older, narrower note). Treat both days as provisional until Wynn publishes a corrected schedule.

detail: Re-reading the official DSE IV page on 2026-11-19 showed rows #3, #4, #5 as '$200 NLH RaceDay Stack (1Day) - Race to finish before the Race' and #35 as '$600 NLH LIPS Poker Jingle Tag Team $10K GTD (1Day) - Tag Teams Consist of Female/Female or Female/Male', where the stored rows stop at the structure-sheet title and carry the suffix in notes. title: A restricted field was counted among the ordinary single-entry picks (the top-ranked event was a Seniors 50+ event)
detail: The Executive Summary's 'highest descriptive guarantee-to-entry ratios' table put the 2 December and 8 December $600 Seniors events at the top of the ordinary ranking, and the day schedule could choose a Seniors, female-only or tag-team event as the day's primary pick. Those rows DO pass S1 (nothing on the sheet sells a second entry), but their own sheets close the field: sheet 17 prints 'MUST BE 50+ YEARS OF AGE TO PARTICPATE', sheet 19 prints 'Open to Female players who must 21+ years of age', and sheet 31 prints 'Teams: Female / Female OR Female / Male'. Fix applied: each such row now carries a sheet-derived restriction label with its sentence and retrieval date, the label is shown on every row, the executive ranking lists them separately as excluded, and the day schedule cannot make one the day's primary event. A reader who is eligible can still play them; the label says who can.
